name: Meditech Expanse
description: Meditech Expanse is MEDITECH's web-based electronic health record platform. Greenfield Workspace is MEDITECH's developer testing ground for applications integrating with Expanse through OAuth2, FHIR DSTU2/R4, US Core R4, interactive documentation, sandbox patients, and customer implementation paths.
agentUseSummary: Connect an authorized MEDITECH Greenfield or customer Expanse FHIR base URL and bearer token after registration and customer approval, then let selected agents inspect discovery and content-minimized FHIR metadata under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: EHR_FHIR_BASE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: MEDITECH Expanse FHIR base URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact HTTPS FHIR DSTU2/R4 or US Core R4 base URL for the authorized Greenfield sandbox or customer Expanse environment.

credentialRequirements.name: EHR_FHIR_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: MEDITECH SMART/FHIR bearer token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use an authorized, revocable token from the MEDITECH-approved OAuth2 client and customer implementation.

capabilities.label: Read SMART/FHIR metadata
capabilities.description: Inspect tenant discovery and content-minimized metadata for allowlisted FHIR resources without exposing raw protected health information.

allowed.label: Read SMART/FHIR discovery
allowed.description: Read the connected MEDITECH SMART configuration and FHIR CapabilityStatement without patient chart payloads.

approvalRequired.label: Search FHIR metadata
approvalRequired.description: Search allowlisted MEDITECH FHIR resources with Relay-bounded query parameters and content-minimized results.

approvalRequired.label: Read FHIR resource metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact allowlisted MEDITECH FHIR resource through Relay's content-minimized projection.

blocked.label: Expose raw chart content
blocked.description: FHIR narratives, notes, attachments, values, addresses, telecom fields, names, identifiers, and raw records are not sent to agents.

blocked.label: Collect portal credentials
blocked.description: Relay never collects MEDITECH Patient Portal, patient portal, provider portal, Google ID, password, passkey, MFA, activation-code, cookie, or browser-session credentials.

blocked.label: Mutate clinical records
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, bulk export, messaging, ordering, scheduling mutation, and administrative EHR actions are outside this V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Discovery runs directly. FHIR resource searches and reads require approval and return only content-minimized metadata.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected read operations run without Relay per-action approval; tenant binding, SMART/FHIR scopes, content minimization, bounds, audits, and token secrecy still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded SMART/FHIR discovery and content-minimized read wrappers; tokens remain server-side.
Railway mounts bounded SMART/FHIR discovery and content-minimized read wrappers; tokens remain server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: MEDITECH Greenfield Workspace requires registration, Greenfield support approval, EULA steps, callback URI submission, OAuth2 client ID and secret provisioning, sandbox testing, and customer implementation for Expanse tenant access before live use. No provider console, account, credential, consent, Railway deployment, or live tenant validation was performed.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay with MEDITECH Greenfield Workspace, complete required legal/support onboarding, configure the Railway callback, receive the OAuth2 client details for sandbox and customer testing, connect an authorized FHIR base URL and token, then verify discovery, content minimization, Safe approvals, token refresh/revocation, disconnect denial, and tenant-bound audit records.

evidence.supports: MEDITECH describes Greenfield Workspace as a testing ground for app developers integrating with Expanse, including US Core FHIR R4 APIs, patient-facing authorization, FHIR Scheduling APIs, and customer-supported workflows.

MEDITECH documents registration, documentation access, OAuth2 documentation, FHIR DSTU2/R4 specs, callback URI submission, OAuth2 client ID and secret provisioning, Authorization Code Grant testing, sandbox testing, and the fact that credentials are received during registration and acceptance.
MEDITECH lists Greenfield Workspace resources for FHIR Patient Access APIs, FHIR DSTU2, FHIR R4, US Core FHIR R4 for USCDI data, and Terms of Use.

MEDITECH RESTful API Infrastructure resources describe OAuth2.0 authorization, OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0 authentication support, Greenfield developer testing, and customer infrastructure responsibilities.
